marc:datafield.marc:subfield: To Dr. Candace Pert, "feeling good" and "feeling God" are one in the same. It may be surprising to hear a world-renowned biologist talking about God, yet Candace Pert is on the vanguard of a new breed of scientists who fearlessly explore the territory where science and spirit meet. On to feel go(o)d, listeners will experience the unique and charismatic style that has made Dr. Pert such a sought-after speaker. On this original audio, Pert blends lucid, accessible explanations of cutting-edge biology, stories of her remarkable personal experiences as she strives toward a cure for AIDS, and inspirational wisdom on how enlightened science can guide us into a state of oneness with the divine
